I have worked with backend concepts such as middleware and database design, and I have used both SQL databases like MySQL and NoSQL databases like MongoDB. I am especially interested in how good structure and architecture impact real-world applications. home.title: A developer in training
home.description:
I’m Alex, a developer based in Stockholm with experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, Vite, Next.js, and backend development. I enjoy building projects from scratch and understanding how frontend, backend, and databases connect.

Through my internships, I have worked with frontend development, bug fixes, TypeScript migration, technical documentation, high-level design documents, and database relationship diagrams. I’m especially interested in backend structure, authentication, database design, and how good architecture affects real-world applications.

I enjoy working with MongoDB because of its flexibility when designing data models, and I like analyzing how websites and systems are structured. I’m looking to contribute to a real team, keep improving, and work on larger projects where I can grow and add value.
